delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: Spawn independent agents with their own memory and skills. Sub-agents at runtime.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Declarative access rules that allow, deny, or request human approval for each capability call, with tool-level granularity
human_in_loop.note: Approval levels STRICT / SMART / AUTO / OFF are configurable.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: Every turn persisted; evicted turns indexed with on-demand recall — nothing summarized away.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Continuously turns conversations and resources into readable, editable, searchable, and linked Markdown memory.
long_term_memory.note: Skills library shipped; roadmap mentions hot-swappable vector models and storage, search implies vector store.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: qwenpaw tui --resume <id> # resume a previous session

self_verification.evidence_quote: Pre-activation scanning with block / warn / off modes and whitelist support.
self_verification.note: No harness-enforced test execution, linting, or judge described; security scanning is a guardrail not self-verification.

rollback.evidence_quote: Browser-use, Computer-use, workspace checkpoints, and long-running conversation continuity.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Kernel-level execution isolation using Seatbelt (macOS), Bubblewrap / Landlock (Linux), and AppContainer (Windows). Shell commands run inside a restricted filesystem view.
execution_isolation.note: Sandboxed host processes, not containers/VMs; Docker deployment of whole app also offered.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Shell commands run inside a restricted filesystem view.
filesystem_access.note: File Guard additionally blocks sensitive paths.

network_policy.evidence_quote: Kernel-level Sandbox, Tool Guard, File Guard, Skill Scanner, and Access Policy. Dangerous commands are blocked before they run.
network_policy.note: No network egress restriction mentioned among the five security layers.

permission_model.evidence_quote: YAML rule engine with `ShellEvasionGuardian` inspects every tool call before execution, detecting command injection, path traversal, reverse shells, and obfuscated attacks.

tracing.evidence_quote: QwenPaw collects **anonymous** usage data during `qwenpaw init`
tracing.note: Per-step trace format not documented; token usage and tool call views exist in console.

replayability.evidence_quote: qwenpaw tui --resume <id> # resume a previous session

eval_hooks.note: No benchmark evaluation runner mentioned in README or visible file tree.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Detects prompt injection, hardcoded secrets, data exfiltration, and more.
guardrails.note: Tool Guard/Access Policy = action_policies; Skill Scanner pre-activation = input_filters.

target_domain.evidence_quote: Your personal AI assistant — deploy locally or in the cloud, extend with Skills & Plugins, connect across every channel.
target_domain.note: Coding Mode and browser skills shipped.
